post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 high just built this Skyraider model in one shot with our threejs skill.

Prompt: "Build a Douglas A-1H Skyraider in Three.js"  

One HTML file. Folding wings, retractable gear, flaps, dive brakes, two paint schemes, and an autopilot flying it over a procedural jungle. Zero 3D models, zero image files. 

I did not expect it to be this good. Next, it becomes part of my Lightning Sortie game.  

What should it be fighting?
